{
  "name": "dsh-context",
  "version": "0.82.1",
  "description": "A DeepSeek Harness plugin for context insight and management, with context dashboard and context command, for understanding how the context is made of, and how it evolves.",
  "icon": "icon.svg",
  "author": "bowenliang123",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git+https://github.com/bowenliang123/dsh-context.git"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/bowenliang123/dsh-context",
  "bugs": {
    "url": "https://github.com/bowenliang123/dsh-context/issues"
  },
  "type": "module",
  "engines": {
    "node": "^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0",
    "dsh": ">=0.2.0-rc.2 || >=0.2.1-rc.2 || >=0.2.2-rc.1"
  },
  "main": "lib/index.js",
  "types": "lib/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "types": "./lib/index.d.ts",
      "default": "./lib/index.js"
    },
    "./client": "./lib/client.js",
    "./package.json": "./package.json",
    "./locale/*.json": "./locale/*.json"
  },
  "files": [
    "icon.svg",
    "locale/*.json",
    "lib/client.js",
    "lib/index.js",
    "lib/index.d.ts",
    "cordis.patch.yml",
    "README.md",
    "LICENSE"
  ],
  "scripts": {
    "build": "tsdown",
    "lint": "oxlint",
    "lint:fix": "oxlint --fix",
    "check": "node scripts/run-bash.mjs scripts/check.sh",
    "watch": "node scripts/watch.mjs",
    "web": "node scripts/web.mjs",
    "register": "node scripts/run-bash.mjs scripts/register.sh",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tests.json --incremental",
    "test": "vitest run --coverage",
    "coverage": "vitest run --coverage",
    "release": "node scripts/run-bash.mjs scripts/publish.sh",
    "social-preview": "node scripts/social-preview/generate.ts",
    "prepare": "husky && tsdown"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "bundle": {
      "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml"
    },
    "client": {
      "inject": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-remotes",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-connection",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right"
      ],
      "platform": "web"
    },
    "compatibility": {
      "dshReleases": {
        "0.2.0-rc.2+": "compatible",
        "0.2.1-rc.2+": "compatible",
        "0.2.2-rc.1+": "compatible"
      }
    }
  },
  "keywords": [
    "deepseek-harness",
    "dsh",
    "cordis",
    "plugin",
    "context",
    "token",
    "ui"
  ],
  "license": "Apache-2.0",
  "dependencies": {
    "zod": "4.4.3"
  },
  "peerDependencies": {
    "@deepseek-ai/cordis": "^4.0.4 || >=4.0.6-alpha.2 <5.0.0",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives": ">=0.2.0-rc.2 || >=0.2.1-rc.2 || >=0.2.2-rc.1",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-session": ">=0.2.0-rc.2 || >=0.2.1-rc.2 || >=0.2.2-rc.1",
    "@deepseek-ai/schemastery": "^3.18.2 || >=3.18.6-alpha.2 <4.0.0",
    "react": "^18.3.1",
    "react-dom": "^18.3.1"
  },
  "peerDependenciesMeta": {
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives": {
      "optional": true
    },
    "react": {
      "optional": true
    },
    "react-dom": {
      "optional": true
    }
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@deepseek-ai/cordis": "4.1.0",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store": "0.2.0-rc.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives": "0.2.0-rc.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-session": "0.2.0-rc.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-projection": "0.2.0-rc.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-util-code-language": "0.2.0-rc.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-util-workspace-path": "0.2.0-rc.2",
    "@deepseek-ai/schemastery": "3.19.0",
    "@opencode-ai/models": "^0.0.87",
    "@shikijs/langs": "^4.5.0",
    "@stylistic/eslint-plugin": "^5.10.0",
    "@tailwindcss/node": "4.3.3",
    "@tailwindcss/oxide": "4.3.3",
    "@types/node": "^26.6.5",
    "@types/react": "^18.3.31",
    "@types/react-dom": "^18.3.7",
    "@vitest/coverage-v8": "^5.0.5",
    "anser": "^2.3.5",
    "clsx": "^2.1.1",
    "diff": "^9.0.0",
    "eslint-plugin-sonarjs": "^4.2.2",
    "husky": "^9.1.7",
    "immer": "^10.2.0",
    "jsdom": "^30.1.3",
    "katex": "^0.16.47",
    "lightningcss": "1.32.0",
    "mdast-util-from-markdown": "^2.1.0",
    "mdast-util-gfm": "^3.1.0",
    "mdast-util-math": "^3.0.0",
    "micromark-core-commonmark": "^2.0.4",
    "micromark-extension-gfm": "^3.0.0",
    "micromark-extension-math": "^3.1.0",
    "micromark-factory-space": "^2.1.0",
    "micromark-util-character": "^2.1.1",
    "micromark-util-classify-character": "^2.0.1",
    "micromark-util-sanitize-uri": "^2.0.1",
    "micromark-util-symbol": "^2.0.1",
    "oxlint": "1.85.0",
    "oxlint-tsgolint": "7.0.2003",
    "react": "^18.3.1",
    "react-dom": "^18.3.1",
    "semver": "^7.8.5",
    "shiki": "^4.5.0",
    "simple-icons": "16.32.0",
    "tsdown": "0.23.1",
    "typescript": "~7.0.2",
    "vitest": "^5.0.5",
    "zustand": "~4.4.7"
  }
}
